images.prompt:
Create original editorial styling images for an established Japanese craft-jewelry catalog. The established palette is warmly lit minimalist product portraiture, with softly textured ivory, warm stone, pale mushroom or faint sage plaster, gentle diffuse window light and simple contemporary solid-colour clothing. Place each model fully indoors on a seamless studio background: no recognisable architecture, streets, greenery, outdoors or landscape. Photorealistic, crisp enough for jewelry detail, gentle and friendly expression, fresh but unmistakably adult faces. All models are fictional Japanese ADULT women in their early twenties. Youthful natural expression and light modern makeup, realistically clear cheeks with absolutely no visible moles, beauty marks, freckles, isolated dark specks or pigmentation patches anywhere on the face, neck or visible skin. No other jewelry, no branding or text. The accessory is an original styling illustration of a broad craft motif.

Produce exactly FOUR separate portraits on a landscape 1536 x 1024 source contact sheet. A precise 2-by-2 grid divided exactly at the horizontal and vertical halves, no gutters, lines, labels or frames. Each cell is a standalone 3:2 LANDSCAPE composition. Keep head, cheeks, accessory and important clothing inside each tile with generous top and side margins, no tile bleeding or reframing. Four visibly distinct faces with different hair, expressions, poses, and gaze. Never have any model look up and to the viewer’s right.
UPPER LEFT: Camellia BROOCH. A cute fictional 21-year-old adult Japanese woman with a black soft bob and slightly wispy bangs, looking straight into the camera with a warm, open, genuine smile, showing a little teeth. Light ivory twill jacket. Small reddish carved wooden camellia brooch pinned high to the visible lapel, face and brooch in the composition. Warm neutral plaster.
UPPER RIGHT: Maple BROOCH. A different fictional 23-year-old adult Japanese woman with a loose side-parted dark chestnut low ponytail, jaw turned slightly toward viewer's left, eyes clearly looking horizontally to the viewer’s LEFT. Gentle happy laughing expression with smile lines. Dusky indigo or slate navy jacket with a clearly visible russet carved wooden brooch showing two pointed maple leaves on the upper front. Pale mushroom plaster.
LOWER LEFT: Camellia PENDANT. A sweet-looking different fictional adult Japanese woman aged 22, with long dark waves, chin angled down slightly, eyes looking DOWN at the flower, soft closed-mouth smile. Fine-knit muted sage blouse. Small carved wood camellia pendant on a thin visible chain at the upper chest. Frame to include her full hair line and entire pendant with breathing room. Ivory plaster backdrop.
LOWER RIGHT: Openwork silver DROP EARRINGS with a warm peach-orange oval stone. A different fictional 24-year-old adult Japanese woman with a smooth cropped dark brown bob tucked behind the displayed ear. Wide natural cheerful smile, eyes lively and looking into the camera. Soft taupe or cream blouse, shoulders relaxed. At least one elongated pierced silver openwork earring with an orange accent stone easily visible between hair and shoulder. Warm grey clean plaster. Keep the face free of any dark flecks or mole, even small ones.
